metadata.subtitle: XX. Prelude in A minor

sections.label: Opening cell
sections.explanation: Upper and middle phrases divide the five-quarter measure differently, while the bass marks its span. Prepared suspensions at bar 4, bar 8 delay the new harmony and resolve downward.

sections.label: Contrasting span
sections.explanation: The characteristic figure returns with changed harmony, density or register. Prepared suspensions at bar 9, bar 13 delay the new harmony and resolve downward.

sections.label: Return
sections.explanation: The characteristic figure returns with changed harmony, density or register.

sections.label: Cadence
sections.explanation: The upper leading note rises by semitone to the tonic; the inner dominant seventh resolves downward.

composition_notes: Upper and middle phrases divide the five-quarter measure differently, while the bass marks its span.
The upper and middle five-beat groupings remain different. The sustained lower layer now carries a continuous voice-led line.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
